Both assistants attempted to write a rhyming poem, but only Assistant A provided a mathematically valid proof (using infinite descent/contradiction). Assistant B's response is mathematically nonsensical—it describes a contradictory geometric scenario without actually proving irrationality—and it is also far longer (24 lines vs. 13). While Assistant A exceeds the "less than 10 lines" constraint, it at least delivers the correct mathematical argument, whereas Assistant B fails on accuracy and relevance.

[[A]]
